Case Study

AstroNova

AI-Powered Astrology Report Platform

An AI-powered platform that generates detailed, personalized astrology reports from astrology chart data. AstroNova combines traditional astrological knowledge with advanced AI to deliver accurate interpretations, structured insights, and beautiful, shareable reports.

Role

Product / Technical Delivery

Industry

Astrology / Spiritual Tech

Timeline

12-16 weeks

Stack

Next.js, Python, PostgreSQL, OpenAI API, Swiss Ephemeris, Redis, Stripe

←Back to projectsBook a consultation→

The Challenge

  • Astrology reports are traditionally time-consuming and complex to create
  • Astrologers needed a faster way to deliver accurate, high-quality reports
  • Maintaining consistency across interpretations and report formats
  • Users wanted beautiful, easy-to-understand reports with deep insights
  • The team needed an AI solution grounded in authentic astrological logic

The Solution

  • Built an AI-enhanced platform that generates astrology reports from chart data
  • AI analyzes planetary placements, aspects, houses and transits to create insights
  • Automated interpretation engine produces structured, comprehensive reports
  • Pre-built templates for different report types (Natal, Compatibility, Transit, etc.)
  • Delivered scalable, accurate and beautifully designed reports in seconds

How It Works

Chart Input

User inputs birth details or uploads chart data.

Data Processing

System calculates planetary positions, houses and aspects.

AI Chart Analysis

AI analyzes placements, aspects and patterns using astrological knowledge and models.

Report Generation

AI compiles interpretations into a structured, easy-to-read astrology report.

Review & Customize

Astrologers review, fine-tune and add personal notes or recommendations.

Deliver & Share

Reports are delivered to clients as beautiful PDFs or secure online links.

Key Features

Chart Management

Create & store birth charts, bulk chart upload, ephemeris integrations, horoscope system options.

AI Report Generation

AI-powered chart analysis, Natal/Transit/Synastry reports, placement & aspect interpretations, personalized insights.

Report Templates

Multiple report types, customizable sections, branded PDF outputs, multi-language support.

Report Library

Organized client reports, search & filter, version history, secure access control.

Client Dashboard

View & download reports, reading history, profile & preferences, secure messaging.

Billing & Subscriptions

Subscription plans, usage & report limits, Stripe integration, invoice management.

My Contribution

Product Strategy

Defined AI report vision, user flows and roadmap.

Requirements

Gathered needs, defined functional and technical requirements.

AI Model Integration

Integrated OpenAI models for natural language astrology insights.

Backend Coordination

Design System & UI
